analyzed_ui.description: The UI displays a privacy consent screen. At the top, the 'OUTFIT7' brand name is visible, followed by an image of Talking Tom and Friends characters. Below the image, there is a detailed privacy statement in Chinese, which includes clickable links to '隐私政策' (Privacy Policy), '儿童隐私保护声明' (Children's Privacy Protection Statement), 'EULA', and '此处' (here) for a list of partners. At the very bottom, there are two buttons: '否' (No) on the left and '是' (Yes) on the right, allowing the user to either decline or agree to the privacy practices.
